source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: RxDart enriches Dart Streams with factories, subjects (BehaviorSubject) and transformers such as switchMap or debounce, built on forwarding_stream. The rxdart_flutter package exposes widgets bound to ValueStreams, used in the GitHub search example.
